C1799.title: Creating “Gossip Groups” to Spread Rumors Convicted as Crime of Picking Quarrels and Provoking Trouble
keywords: Creating “Gossip Groups” to Spread Rumors Convicted as Crime of Picking Quarrels and Provoking Trouble
crime of picking quarrels and provoking trouble
C1799.summary: The Jiading District People's Court of Shanghai found that defendants Xiao Wang and Xiao Li, knowing the information was fabricated, still disseminated it widely online, causing serious disruption to public order, constituting the crime of picking quarrels and provoking trouble. They were sentenced to nine months and seven months in prison respectively, with criminal tools confiscated. The case involves using online groups to spread rumors; the defendants did not appeal after sentencing.
